sous_titre: Millions de voitures sorties des usines allemandes, année 2025

Tout électrique.texte: Their production was expanded by 15% to 1.22mn vehicles in 2025.

Hybride rechargeable.texte: plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEVs), whose production increased by 54% to 0.45mn units

Ensemble électrifié.texte: 1.67mn electric passenger cars were manufactured domestically, 23% more than in the previous year, 2024.
